eventDetail.scope: CVEI 2026 will be held as a key international academic event focusing on computer vision, embodied intelligence, and their cross-application, featuring keynote speeches and technical sessions to drive innovation and development in related fields; the conference will bring together global researchers, engineers, and experts to share cutting-edge progress, tackle core technical challenges, and foster industry-academia collaboration, covering key topics including computer vision and machine vision, image segmentation and object detection, 3D computer vision and point cloud processing, visual tracking and motion analysis, industrial computer vision and applications, fundamental large models for embodied intelligence, embodied intelligent system design and optimization, embodied robot system integration and deployment, computer vision-based embodied perception, multimodal visual interaction in embodied systems, visual-guided embodied motion control, and human-embodied agent interaction
